subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: What proof is sufficient to close this canonical issue after the open prompt-projection and provider/media fixes are resolved?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the remaining symptom depends on long-session model-visible payload behavior that helper tests and UI-only coverage do not fully prove.

options.title: Require installed long-session proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated with a redacted WebChat, Telegram, Discord, or equivalent installed-session run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool output text.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof
options.body: Close once the focused prompt-projection PR lands with green helper coverage, accepting that installed-channel proof can follow in QA.

options.title: Split remaining causes
options.body: Close only the aggregate-truncation part after proof and keep separate provider/media placeholder issues or PRs for payload-less media hardening.

recommendation.title: Require installed long-session proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated with a redacted WebChat, Telegram, Discord, or equivalent installed-session run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool output text.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main session projection fix and are the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether helper-level or installed-session proof is enough.
